name: io.github.anhyobin/aws-blog-mcp
title: AWS Blog MCP (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server to search and read AWS Korea tech blog posts (AWS 기술 블로그) as markdown.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_BLOG_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for messages written to stderr: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_BLOG_MCP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent sent to aws.amazon.com (default: aws-blog-mcp/<version> plus the project URL).
